request.subject: PORTRAIT:UNDEAD:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Redraw him as an armoured barrow-king. His head becomes a huge closed weathered grey iron great helm with rust patches that hides the whole skull, with two glowing bright violet eye slits and a spiky tarnished bronze crown on top; no face shows. Big round grey iron pauldrons with tarnished bronze rims on the shoulders. The sword becomes the broad light grey blade of a notched greataxe beside the helm. Keep proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
